integrity_violations_status_shape_check.name: integrity_violations_status_shape_check
integrity_violations_status_shape_check.value:
(
        ("status" = 'expunged' and "expunged_at" is not null)
        or ("status" <> 'expunged' and "expunged_at" is null)
      ) and (
        ("status" = 'proposed' and "reviewer_user_id" is null)
        or ("status" in ('active', 'dismissed') and "reviewer_user_id" is not null)
        or ("status" = 'expunged')
      )

submissions_binding_check.name: submissions_binding_check
submissions_binding_check.value: not ("course_id" is not null and "mastery_topic_id" is not null)
